headline: Federal Reserve Officials Signal Further Interest Rate Hikes Ahead
summary: Federal Reserve officials indicated that additional interest rate hikes will be necessary soon, while noting that the pace of tightening remains a key question for monetary policy.
why: Federal Reserve monetary policy decisions and interest rate trajectories dictate global borrowing costs, currency valuations, and equity market valuations.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: Signals of impending rate hikes directly point to higher future central bank policy rates.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Statements from central bank officials pointing toward impending rate hikes alter market expectations for monetary tightening.
